inputs.text: A single enemy character render for a dark fantasy action RPG: a small hunched goblin seen from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle, full body, centered on a flat solid pure chroma magenta #ff00ff background filling the whole frame, no floor, no contact shadow, no gradient, no vignette, no scenery. Sickly green skin (about #5d8f3a), oversized pointed ears, a wide flat face with sharp teeth and bright curious eyes, long ape-like arms, wiry fast silhouette, mid-stride running to the camera-left with the left leg reaching forward and the right arm swung back for balance. It wears ragged leather scraps and stolen bits of rusted mail tied with cord, and clutches a crude jagged cleaver. Dark Gothic Fantasy, realistic stylization, painterly detail and believable organic and material surfaces: matte leather, dull pitted mail. Muted palette only: green skin against muted brown #594536 rags, ash grey #68666A stolen mail, obsidian #171719 shadow. The goblin must read as a small, quick, fragile swarmling, smaller and lower than an armored hero. No text, no watermark.
